hash.def: A number computed from a key that tells a dictionary or set which slot to look in. Equal keys always have equal hashes.

hashable.def: A value that cannot change (number, string, tuple), so it can be a dictionary key or set member. Lists, dicts and sets are not hashable.

complement.def: For a target sum \(t\), the partner a value \(x\) needs: \(t-x\). Looking it up in a dict of values already seen solves two-sum in \(O(n)\).

signature.def: A hashable value that is equal for two items exactly when they belong in the same group, e.g. the sorted letters of a word for anagrams.

anagram.def: A word or phrase made of exactly the same letters as another, each used the same number of times (listen, silent).
